spans.s:
The affix ण्य comes in the sense of descendant after the words कुरु etc.

Terms: ण्य

The affix ण्य comes after the word कुरु and a word beginning with न when these words denote a country being the name of a क्षत्रिय tribe also.

Terms: ण्य

The first member retains its accent in the following - 1. कुरु-गार्हपत 2. रिक्त-गुरु 3. असूत-जरती 4. अश्लील-दृढ-रूपा 5. पारे-वडवा 6. तैतिल-कद्रूः 7. पण्य-कम्बलः and 8. दासीभार etc.

Terms: समास accent
